subject: [RFC PATCH 57/57] MAINTAINERS: add an entry for collapse

reviews.author: Lorenzo Stoakes (ARM)
reviews.summary: Suggested that the patch should have the same maintainers and reviewers as the rest of THP, implying a potential need for changes.

reviews.author: David Hildenbrand (Arm)
reviews.summary: Agreed with Lorenzo's suggestion, implying that the patch may need to be revised.

2026-08-16.patch_summary: This RFC patch proposes to extract the THP collapse logic into its own module, mm/collapse.c, and update the MAINTAINERS file accordingly. The patch aims to separate the collapse functionality from the khugepaged daemon and MADV_COLLAPSE, making it a standalone feature.

reviews.author: Kiryl Shutsemau
reviews.summary: Clarified that the patch is a separation of THP collapse logic and should not be merged without proper review.
reviews.raw_body:
On Mon, Aug 17, 2026 at 10:08:32AM +0200, David Hildenbrand (Arm) wrote:
> On 8/17/26 10:04, Lorenzo Stoakes (ARM) wrote:
> >> diff --git a/MAINTAINERS b/MAINTAINERS
> >> index 7c179b333e4e..4e4e5030b979 100644
> >> --- a/MAINTAINERS
> >> +++ b/MAINTAINERS
> >> @@ -16955,6 +16955,20 @@ T:	git git://git.kernel.org/pub/scm/linux/kernel/git/akpm/mm
> >>  F:	include/linux/balloon.h
> >>  F:	mm/balloon.c
> >>
> >> +MEMORY MANAGEMENT - COLLAPSE
> >> +M:	Kiryl Shutsemau <kas@kernel.org>
> >> +L:	linux-mm@kvack.org
> >> +S:	Maintained
> >> +W:	http://www.linux-mm.org
> >> +T:	git git://git.kernel.org/pub/scm/linux/kernel/git/akpm/mm
> >> +F:	include/linux/khugepaged.h
> >> +F:	include/trace/events/collapse.h
> >> +F:	mm/collapse.c
> >> +F:	mm/collapse.h
> >> +F:	mm/khugepaged.c
> >> +F:	mm/mm_slot.h
> >> +F:	tools/testing/selftests/mm/khugepaged*.c
> >> +
> > 
> > I'll look through the series properly, but presumably this is a separation of
> > the THP collapse logic, and therefore should have the same maintainers/reviewers
> > as the rest of THP.
> 
> Jup.

Sure.  I just didn't want to volunteer anybody here.

-- 
  Kiryl Shutsemau / Kirill A. Shutemov

2026-08-17.patch_summary: This RFC patch proposes to extract the THP collapse logic into its own module, mm/collapse.c, and update the MAINTAINERS file accordingly. The patch aims to separate the collapse functionality from the khugepaged daemon and MADV_COLLAPSE, making it a standalone feature.
